balls.text: the perfect yorker on leg stump, Raina looks to turn it away square and gets banged on the boot. Starc goes up in appeal, but this would have slid down.
shortish and outside off, Raina looks to cut it away but misses completely
goes full and wide, Jaddu finds long-on.
fullish on middle, Jaddu lashes it down the ground for a couple
drew him outside off and Jaddu is good enough to slice it over the three man patrolling the point region. Gayle runs after it, gets in front of the ball and flicks it back with his boot
fullish and wide outside off, Raina looks to blast it through the covers but ends up inside edging to short fine leg
goes for the wild hoick and gets a thick outside edge that skews off to deep third man
he's brilliant on the boundary! This was soundly hit as Raina moved across to off stump and carved it through the covers. Starc had to rush to his left and slide to keep it in the field of play.
uses the open face this time as he keeps it full and outside off. Gets a couple to cover.
fullish and outside off, Jaddu powers it down to long-on for a single
angled in and it's a little too full, Raina gets his front foot down the pitch and drills it to long-on
well bowled. Jaddu was down the track, but Nechim hurled a wide yorker and keeps him to a single
full and wide outside off, Jaddu looks to flay it through the covers but his middle isn't as obliging as his inside edge. The slower pitch is messing with the batsman's timing
keeps it full and straight and Raina benefits from another thick inside edge towards short fine leg
hurls in a yorker on middle, Raina gets an inside edge towards deep square leg
fullish and outside off, Raina dabs with an open face and gets an inside edge which is reined in by the keeper
full and outside off, Jaddu comes forward and whips it to deep square leg
goes for a front-foot pull and connects a little too high for his liking. Travels a good distance in the air, but long-on is back
full on off stump, Raina closed the face too early and gets a leading edge into the covers
the wide yorker works. Raina goes down with it and tries to steer it away bit in vain
this time he goes short and Jaddu pulls off the back foot. Single to deep square leg
goes around the wicket to the left-hander. Gets a short of a good length delivery to just nip away off the seam late enough for Jaddu to flash and miss
short ball and Dhoni has slapped it straight into the hands of point. Gayle dives, and if that isn't news enough, Super Kings' trump card walks back after six balls. No finishing today.
offers a full and wide delivery which is driven to extra cover to bring up his fifty, his second of the season
a little shorter so Raina has a little more time to read the wrong 'un and steer it past point
wanders down the track, but Chahal pulled the length back and almost had his man. This was the googly and Raina just about got bat to ball
better line and Dhoni pushes the tossed up delivery on middle down to long-off
swept fine and it has enough legs to reach the boundary. Not quite as well flighted and Dhoni puts it away with minimum fuss
loopy legspinner which drifts in on the pads, Dhoni, wary of the turn he gets, defends
flighted but on the pads, Raina sweeps but doesn't connect properly. But Dhoni is quick to hurtle across to the other end
flighted just outside off, Dhoni comes forward and works it to long leg for a couple
backs away a touch and taps it into the covers
good length ball, turning from leg stump. Defended into the covers and they almost collide with each other in the search for a quick single
do not hit it in the air to Mitchell Starc in the outfield. Period. This was a little short and Huss saw an easy escape as he pulls, but he picked the man almost perfectly
chips down the track and pushes down to long-off
turned away behind square leg and Gayle finds it hard to get down and employs the boot
goes for the sweep but there is too much turn on it for him to connect

this time he manages to beat Murali on his left. Waited for the slower, length ball and guided it so very fine. Didn't try to imbue power into the stroke. Murali runs after it and tries to pull out the big boot, but his efforts were in vain.
"Wait," cries Huss as Raina uses the open face to find short third man
set up for a slash over the off side, but the slower ball doesn't afford him enough room. Pushed down the ground for a single
angled down the leg side, tucked away to the right of short fine leg
full on off stump, turned away to deep midwicket.
clipped away to deep square leg. Took it from off stump as he went back in his crease
away she goes. Raina advances to the pitch and smites it with the turn into the crowd behind long-on

whoa! That's loads of turn! This was drifted in on middle and leg and Huss set up for the flick through midwicket. But after pitching the ball rips outside off and takes the outside edge to short third man
this time there's more conviction behind the shot as he lofts down the ground to long-off. AB won't let it go through
nips down the track a bit, but has to settle for a defensive push
flighted on the pads, worked down to long-on
that's his first six of the season and it clatters into the sightscreen. Just a little more flight and Huss gave himself room and carved it down the ground
goes back and whips it from off stump down the ground to long-on
goes back to a good length ball, which grips and turns. Raina was looking for a flick and then stops himself as he lets the ball strike the bottom of the bat and picks up a single towards cover
tossed up just outside off, Huss rushes down the pitch and chips it over the infield. Deep midwicket is on hand though
flighted on leg, nudged to short fine leg
drags this one down short and Raina goes deep in his crease and pulls to the square leg boundary. Fell on his back but thankfully he had timed it well
dances down the track and lashes it through short extra cover. And some brisk running gets them a couple
good length ball on middle, Huss defends down the ground. Although with a whole lot of wrist than necessary
slower bouncer and Raina was into the shot way too early. Midway through the shot he takes evasive action and manages to pull the ball down to long leg
this was the cross-seamed delivery angled into the off stump, Raina holds his ground and steers this into the third man boundary
this time he takes full toll. Drags this from outside off and the short ball is carted away to the square leg boundary. Again a short ball doesn't get enough height
short ball slid down the leg side, didn't rise anywhere near enough to trouble Raina. Should have been pulled for a boundary that
more work for third man as Huss stays leg side of the shortish ball and dabs at it
just enough room on the shortish ball to be steered down to third man
whipped to the other side of the ground to long-on. Raina absolutely content with single
tossed up on off stump, pushed down the ground
this time he drifts a little too close to leg stump and it's picked away through square leg
big appeal from Chahal. This was the legspinner that pitched and turned. Huss flicks across the line and gets hit on the front pad, but it might not have turned enough
tossed up just outside off and Raina drives down the ground to long-off
flighted just outside off, driven into the covers
slower ball, picked and punched down the ground to long-off
that's a beaut! Pushed a back of a good length delivery across the left-hander and Raina just hung his bat out to dry. Little nip away off the seam does him in
pushed across him and Raina hangs his bat out to dry. Moved away off the seam there
can't beat extra cover as he pushes at a good length ball just outside off
fullish on off stump, Raina is forward with a straight bat and pushes to long-off
dabbed past the keeper to deep third man. Nechim is the new bowler and he sticks to a channel just outside off
waited for it to turn and Huss goes deep in his crease and whips it down to long-on. Loads of wrist work there
tapped down the ground off the back foot as Chahal goes a little short
on middle and leg and Raina covers his stumps and nudges into the on side
that's the googly and he was left groping for it. Open face of the bat following the flighted delivery outside off
stays on the back foot and steers the good length ball towards point
lovely flight and he targets off stump, Huss pushes to the sweeper on the off side
a little shorter this time and Huss taps it down the ground to long-on
rips from outside off and Huss tries to nudge it away off his knees. Murali's begun spinning that old web
pulls his length back but it's the one that turned the other way. Huss is on the back foot as he blocks
doosra now, pitched just outside off stump and Huss comes forward to block
how did he not get that?! This was looped up on off stump and lured Huss into a cover drive. The ball gripped and turned and took the inside edge and lobbed over the stumps to the fine leg boundary
turns right across from middle and Huss almost lost his balance as he went for the flick. But he managed to get his back foot grounded
flighted outside off, Huss shuffles across and blocks
there's his escape route. Full and angled into the pads, a neat little tickle to deep square leg
bit of room, but Huss drives straight to cover. Sweet timing.
fullish and outside off, Huss uses the open blade to push into the covers
gets behind the good length ball and Raina is a little tentative in defence. Gets an inside edge to long leg
ducks back in but Raina is able to ride the bounce and the late cut just scurries away. Third man had no chance
gifts a full toss on the pads and Raina has casually clipped it off his legs. The yorker gone wrong and that's just about the best ball a new batsman can get
gets behind a slower short ball and blocks on middle
full and straight, nudged to mid-on with a lot of wrist work
another one and Aaron has paid off in his call back and how! Hurried into him with a short ball and Smith's pull skews off a top edge. AB's at cover and picks up a simple reverse-cup catch
takes it from the off stump and flicks the shortish ball to square leg

tees off again and when Starc is in the vicinity you'd better tuck your bat under your arms and walk off. Back of a length again from the bowler and Baz cleared his front leg to flay it over midwicket. But this time there was a man there

finally trickles into the midwicket boundary. Dances down to one just back of a good length and went through with a loft. Didn't get it off the middle, but he picked the gap well enough to reap dividends
full and a little bit of room on offer, Baz says thank you with a slap to long-off
waits on his back foot and turns it away through midwicket
keeps attacking the stumps and Smith keeps it out

that was a chance! And AB doesn't hit the target! It was pushed into the covers and they made a bit of late decision for the single. The fielder rushes in and sort of looped the throw past the stumps. Where was the one-bounce hurl?
angled into the pads and Smith looks for the whip. After being a little slow on the shot, he has to settle for a leg bye behind point
goes full and straight, Smith looks to hack it through midwicket but mistimes it. Finds the fielder

top edge for six, it's not an IPL match without one. Aaron goes short and gets some decent pace and height on this. But to his chagrin, this flies off Baz's bat and over the fine leg boundary comfortably
goes short and has Smith in a little bit of trouble. He was slow on the flat-batted swipe and gets a bit of an edge towards extra cover
that was punched! And he held his pose, head down, high front elbow. Straight drive from the top draw. Although the bowler did err by pitching it up too much and his power did the rest
nips down the track and Aaron angles it into the pads, flicked calmly through square leg
not too much footwork there as Aaron fires it in full and straight. Baz looks to smash it over mid-on but inside-edges onto his back pad. Lucky
arches himself back to get enough room to guide a shortish ball outside off to deep third man
belted to mid-off as he runs down the track and turns a length ball into a half-volley.
targets middle and off with a good length ball, Baz blocks towards point
this is a terrific over. It's a yorker dead on off stump this time. Smith manages to intervene and has hit is soft enough into the off side to take refuge at the other end
three in a row! Smith plants his front leg down and looks to maul the full and wide delivery over mid-off. No dice
did him in again! This one is a little closer to off and Smith was looking to tap it past the slips to third man. Just back of a good length ball skims past the open face
has a slash and misses. Starc works the angle across the right-hander and gets a moral victory
keeps it to a good length, but he keeps it on leg again. McCullum can't connect with the flick and is struck on the pad again
pushes it through on leg stump, he tries to work it to fine leg but wears it on the pad

lashed down the ground and it goes all the way! Affords a little bit more room on this occasion and there is no spin so early in the innings. Baz hit through the line with no thought of keeping it down
looped up on middle, Baz strides forward to block
manages to tickle one to short fine leg and get off strike. Murali looking to cramp the batsman up
starts around the wicket as he flights it on middle and leg, Smith looks to flick through midwicket and misses. Leg before appeal turned down
dances down the track first ball and smites it to the long-on boundary. That's the game for Royal Challengers and they stay alive in the IPL. Kohli and Gayle are trapped in a bear hug with each other
flighted outside off, Rana has pummeled it into the hands of short midwicket! He had nailed that, but Baz leaps up to his right and plucked a blinder
fast and flat on off stump, Yuvi slices it to short third man. Scores are tied, Dhoni asks his field to come up
bowls a flat one outside off and Yuvi belts it for a couple to deep midwicket
in the slot and Yuvi has launched it over wide long-on. He murders spin and this is only part-time spin
finds the block hole and Yuvi retains strike with a push to long-off
stays put in his crease this time and pulls, gets a thick inside edge which runs away towards the long leg boundary until Mithum Manhas intervenes
wanders out of the crease but Jaddu pulls his length back and flummoxes Yuvi's timing again
employs the sweep this time, but still can't out bat to ball
loads and loads of turn that stymies Yuvi's pull. He had set up for a pull, but the ball darts into him too quickly
flighted on middle, Rana has flicked it to deep midwicket

another twist! AB has top edged a slog sweep. The RCB fans had their heads in their hands as they saw Jaddu hustling in off the boundary. He had a lot of ground to cover and he was quick enough to make it seem a pretty straight forward catch
shortish and pushed through outside off. Skids on and gets the bottom edge as AB wanted to pierce the cover gap
angled into his pads and Yuvi sweeps to long leg
slid down leg and AB goes for a pull. Too wide for him to connect and the keeper can't stop it either
skips down the track and swiped it to deep midwicket and collects two
tries to find the block hole, but AB stays nice and deep and has hammered it to the boundary past a desperately diving long-on
looped it up outside off and AB has slog swept it over the midwicket boundary. That could be the clincher

he's got his man, but is it one hit too late? Dupes Gayle with his length and the turn he gets as the batsman moved outside leg. He was looking for another big hit, but seeing the ball not in his arc, he looked to defend with an open face and is beaten. And to make matters worse, off stump is knocked back
that's outta here! This was flighted and it got some turn as well, but Gayle wound up and clobbered it straight. No question about where the ball was landing
its the orthodox offspinner this time and AB has moved too far across to connect with the sweep. Misses leg stump by a whisker and goes off for byes after it deflects off Dhoni's leg
he's outfoxed Ashwin! Moved across outside off stump, went so very very deep in his crease and pulled this carrom ball over the square leg boundary
goes back and slaps it through the covers and gets off strike
pushed through on middle and off, Gayle goes back and punches it back to the bowler
there's the boundary ball and AB capitalises. Sends it soaring over the square leg boundary as Huss bowls one a little too short. Time out now
loads and loads of turn and AB misses a pull and gets hit below his stomach
flatter delivery is helped by the pitch as it turns even further away from Gayle's reach. Gets a bottom edge down to long-on
goes down and turns the flighted ball into a full toss. Timed to the left of deep midwicket and Jaddu runs around and keeps it to a single
hoicked to deep midwicket for a couple
walks across outside off as AB looks to sweep. Gets struck on the pads, but the impact was a little too high reckons the umpire
goes for the trifecta, but this time he can't reach the flatter delivery pushed outside off
all the way! Gets underneath another length ball and since Jaddu was trying to keep it off his pads, he offers enough room for Gayle to cart it well over long-on
this time he drags it from outside off and mauls it over midwicket.
sliced to extra cover, who leaps up in hopes of catching it but it bursts through his hands. I had originally thought it was a bump ball but it was a chance!

loads of excitement as AB misses a reverse sweep. This flighted ball gets considerable rip and beats the shot. His back leg had been drawn outside the crease, but AB manages what Kohli couldn't. He pushes his back foot back before Dhoni can nip the bails off

saw him coming down and he fired it flat and outside off. Kohli tries to reach out as far as he could, but the pitch enables the ball to turn a lot more than he anticipated. He must have known he was in trouble halfway through his shot and though he tries his best to push that back leg of his back to safety, it gets stuck on the line. Dhoni takes care of the rest
goes for a sweep, loops off his pads into the off side
shortish and outisde off as he sees the batsman using his feet. Kohli lashes it down the ground
this time he jumps outside off and looks for a sweep. It dribbles off his pads and Kohli calls him through for the single. He's looking terribly laborious out there
good length, pushed through on off stump. Flicked into the on side
skips down the track and eases it through extra cover. For only a single. Kohli punches his thighs in frustration
backs away outside leg and Raina bowls it fuller and wide of his reach. Gayle flat bats it down to long-off
more fancy footwork on the boundary. This was taken off a length and Kohli's wrists had imbued enough power on it to hurtle towards the deep midwicket boundary. But Smith down there does good work
keeps to a good length on off stump, Gayle goes for a heave-ho and gets an inside edge. Calls for a new bat
fullish on off stump, driven down the ground but the bowler sticks out his left hand to keep it to a dot
calmly clipped away off his hips to deep square leg. He's looking very assured out there
looks to whip the good length ball into the leg side. Had to play across the line and he can't connect well. The ball wanders away into he covers and he finally gets on his bike
slides one down the pads of the batsman who misses a flick. But the ump reckons there was a bit of trouser on it
whipped to deep midwicket as Raina angles it in on a good length from around the wicket
advances down the pitch and picks up a single straight of midwicket
goes down the track and eases it behind the vacant square leg area
that's a reverse swat! When was the last time Gayle had to play something like that? It was a touch short and had enough room for him to use the innovation. Struck quite hard too
nudged down to long-on as this has a little more flight outside off
pushed through and Kohli isn't able to short-arm pull it away as well as he would like
flighted outside off, Gayle looks to launch it over cow corner but can't reach it
belted down the ground and Gayle was quite late in taking evasive action. It was heading for his helmet, but ends up a single to long-on
excellent use of the feet and unleashes a Kohli special over extra cover. Wasn't flighted enough that he could get to the pitch, but he went through with the stroke and connected near perfectly
gets some turn off a good length ball, Gayle sweeps to deep backward square leg
pushed too far outside off to draw Gayle's interest
this time he goes back and cuts strongly in front of point. Is Gayle finding his timing?
goes forward to a wide delivery, but he can't breach the point field
that's what RCB needed. A confided Kohli coming down the track and banishing a short ball from Raina into the wide long-on boundary.
flighted on the pads, Gayle goes for the sweep and collects a single to the right of short fine leg
shortish delivery, but it was quite slow. Gayle looks to pull and gets it off the bottom of the bat and the ricochet goes onto the boot
this time Ashwin fumbles. Kohli places it to his right but he is a little slow to set off
skips down the track but his flick can't beat square leg
keeps it well away from his hitting arc as he goes for a good length outside off, Gayle looks to cut and gets an inside edge. That shall be the time out
this time the outside edge skews away straight down the ground. Flighted ball scythed down the ground
fuller delivery and Kohli slices it to cover
again, Kohli waits on his back foot set up for the late cut but cautions himself as the ball gets a lot more bite off the pitch
tries it again, but this time Jaddu gets enough turn and bounce to beat him
waits on it and then guides it past the lone slip fielder. Wonderful hands from Kohli
turn for Raina as well, and this seemed to keep a touch low. Kohli doesn't mind as he flicks it away to deep midwicket
clipped away through to midwicket
pushes him back with a skidder on middle and leg, Gayle keeps it out
goes down the track, but this is pushed through flatter. Kohli whips it away to square leg
punched towards mid-on
good length ball to start Raina's spell and Kohli defends off the back foot

he was into the shot a few hours before the ball arrived. Runs off his thighs and Raina chases it down. Dives and pulls the ball back, but in the process had disturbed the advertising hoardings. So he takes the time to pull it back and then throws the ball. Absolute belief that Gayle can't run too fast
flighted on middle and Kohli drives down the ground
looks like his role is to stifle the batsmen, but this leg stump line is leaking runs. Kohli goes for the sweep and has tickled it fine enough
pushed through on the pads and Gayle works a single into the leg side
slides one down the leg side and it's a little too far for Gayle to connect with a sweep
he has mauled that! Allowed him the room to free his arms and Gayle has launched the length ball out of the park over midwicket
tossed up on middle, Kohli goes for the sweep and inside edges it to midwicket
another beaut to end the over. Flighted on middle and off, Gayle nudges forward to block but is left groping as it turns past him into the keeper's gloves
backs away and cuts to the man at extra cover
flighted outside leg, Gayle sweeps and can't connect
just a touch short and Gayle looks to cut. Gets it off the bottom of the bat
he is unplayable here, tossed up on middle and Gayle prods forward to defend. But the ball rips across his outside edge
yorker on off stump! He didn't like Gayle moving around in the crease and fired one in. This had a little bit of drift in as well.
shortish and outside off, Kohli plays within himself as he cuts behind point
another googly which skids onto the bat, Kohli dabs to short third man
this was the wrong 'un just outside off, Kohli goes back and pushes to the bowler
ventures towards off stump and Gayle goes for another sweep. It's too full for the stroke and he gets an inside edge towards short fine leg
goes down the track, but Badree pulls his length back. Makes him block
he has a slip in place, but the flighted delivery is at the pads. Gayle sweeps to short fine leg
flighted on off stump, but this time Gayle reaches far enough forward to block
slows it up and Gayle is lured into a poke outside off. Soundly beaten. Amazing control of flight from Ashwin
good length ball just outside off, Kohli shuffles across and flicks it through square leg
the sweep seems to be his get out of trouble shot, but this time it's caused his downfall. Ashwin gets a little more bounce and the ball loops off the back of the bat towards first slip
grips into the pitch and Parthiv was backing away to cut, misses
he's in his element. Flighted from around the wicket and it whizzes past the outside edge
down the track and he's drilled it back to the bowler, who shells it. The crowd think it's a catch, but it was a bump ball.
backs way outside leg and goes for a laborious-looking sweep shot. Takes a while to get back up
nudged into the midwicket region as Badree continues to tuck him up on leg stump
keeps to his leg stump and Gayle has clipped it easily to deep midwicket
looped up on the pads again, Parthiv clips to deep square leg
flighted on middle and leg, turned away into the on side
goes back as he sees this one on a length, but the turn away makes reach out. Gets it off the bottom of the bat as his attempted cut shot goes back to the bowler
how much did that last ball contribute to this shot. Goes for a reverse sweep as this is tossed up on middle. Managed a little bat on it which saves him from the leg before appeal
tons of turn there. He flights it just outside off and the ball grips and turns considerably. Parthiv came forward to block and he was nowhere close
flighted outside off, Parthiv drives into the covers
scoots in low at him as the surface gives off a puff of dust. Picked away into the midwicket region
gets turn early as he pitches on off stump. Gayle stays back and blocks away from the body
good length ball on and around off stump, Parthiv uses the open face to find point
he's having no trouble with this pitch. It was a poor ball though as he targeted the pads of the batsman. Parthiv whipped it away to square leg
the bowler makes the predictable adjustment as he pulls his length back and Parthiv can cut it to point
whistles away! Just a touch overpitched and all Patel did was push it down the ground. He's timed the ball impeccably well there
gets a little seam away, but it was pushed a little too far across the left-hander for him to reach
back of a good length, but he directs it on the pads. Gayle taps it through midwicket to get off the mark
